about: Round 34: a pressure stroke's outline (Freehand.outlinePath) and its width factors, as both phones draw them. outline: points (in the stroke's own box, page units) and the radius at each; the left edge is each point moved out along the normal to the line there (the line's way turned a quarter anticlockwise on the page, y down; at an end, the way to or from its neighbour; where the way is nothing, the normal before, else straight up), smoothed through the midpoints as a stroke is (M, then Q control and the midpoint to the next, the last Q to the last point twice); then a half circle A r r 0 0 1 round the end to the right edge, that edge back the same way, a half circle round the start, Z. One point is a circle of two arcs. Numbers to the hundredth, a whole number with no point. pressure: a Pencil's pressure (0…1 of its most) to a width factor, 0.35 + 0.65 p to the hundredth; speed: a finger's speed in page units a second to 1 - 0.65 min(v, 2000)/2000, to the hundredth.
